obsession: {name} has become obsessed with this particular piece of {object}.
{name} refuses to leave the {object}. It's been there for days.
{name} has claimed the {object} and returns to it constantly.
friend: {name} and {other} spend all their time grazing side by side.
molt: {name} molted overnight and is hiding until the new shell hardens.
A perfect molt from {name}. The empty shell sits on the substrate like a ghost.
{name} shed its skin and is looking a little bigger.
moltFail: {name} got stuck in its molt. It didn't make it.
A failed molt. {name} is gone. Check your GH and keep the water steady.
berried: {name} is berried! A clutch of {n} eggs tucked under her tail.
After the molt, {name} was chased around the tank by every male. She's carrying {n} eggs now.
{name} is fanning a fresh clutch of {n} eggs.
hatch: {name}'s eggs hatched. {n} shrimplets are hiding in the moss.
Tiny specks are moving on the glass. {name}'s clutch hatched: {n} survived.
{n} new shrimplets from {name}. They're almost invisible.
hatchNone: {name}'s eggs hatched, but none of the shrimplets survived the first day. Not enough biofilm to eat.
{name} dropped her eggs. The water wasn't steady enough.
death: {name} was found lying on its side. {cause}
oldAge: {name} passed away peacefully after {n} days. A long life for a shrimp.
{name} was one of the old guard. {n} days in the tank. The others gathered around for a while.
newMorph: A new colour morph has appeared: {morph}! You've never seen one of these in this tank before.
Something unexpected hatched. One of the shrimplets is a {morph}.
mutation: One of {name}'s offspring carries a mutation nobody in the tank had before.
A spontaneous mutation showed up in {name}'s clutch. It may not show until later generations.
stageUp: {name} has reached adult size and its colour is filling in.
snailArrive: A tiny bladder snail hitchhiked in on the {object}. There is never just one.
Where did that snail come from? It must have come in with the {object}.
snailBreed: More snails. They're breeding on the leftover food.
A cluster of jelly snail eggs appeared on the glass.
snailBoom: The snail population is out of control. Feed less.
You count the snails. You stop counting the snails.
algaeBloom: The glass is turning green. Too much light, too many nutrients.
Hair algae is creeping over the driftwood. The shrimp seem to like picking at it, at least.
overgrown: The water lettuce has taken over the surface. The plants below are getting shaded.
The moss has grown into a giant tangle. The shrimplets love it.
waterWarn: The water has a faint sharp smell. Ammonia is rising.
Nitrite is showing on the test. The shrimp are hiding more than usual.
Nitrates are creeping up. Time for a water change.
moltWave: The water change triggered a molting wave. Empty shells everywhere.
Fresh water always does it: half the tank molted overnight.
idle: {name} spent the afternoon cleaning its antennae on the {object}.
{name} did a slow lap of the tank and went back to the {object}.
{name} and {other} bumped into each other and both pretended it didn't happen.
{name} sat perfectly still on the {object} for hours. Thinking, probably.
{name} tried to steal a pellet from {other} and got flicked away.
{name} is picking at the biofilm on the {object} with great focus.
{name} found a spot on the {object} where the light hits just right.
{name} swam a loop, stopped, and seemed surprised to be where it was.
The snail and {name} are sharing the {object}. Neither seems to mind.
{name} has been fanning its little legs at nothing in particular.
{name} climbed to the top of the {object} and surveyed its domain.
{name} ate a chunk of the old molt. Waste not.
away: While you were away: {days} days passed, {births} shrimplets hatched, {deaths} lost.
